label: Chapter 99
english: Yet another monk said, ‘I strip away pleasures in order to eliminate excuses for anger. I know that [anger] always fights for pleasures and disturbs my nous and chases knowledge away.’ One of the elders said that love does not know how to store up food or money. And the same [monk] said, ‘I do not know that I have ever been deceived twice by the demons on the same matter.’
